description: Prepare a bounded threat-model intake or interpret an explicitly supplied output from the pinned Ansvar workflow for a defined system.

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.source: Full pinned Lawve source subtree and original per-source manifest/notices are retained byte-for-byte in references/upstream/.
provenance.license: Exact source declarations and notices preserved; permission determination belongs to licensing owner.

routing.when_to_use: Prepare a bounded threat-model intake or interpret an explicitly supplied output from the pinned Ansvar workflow for a defined system.
when_not_to_use: A different, distinct task is requested
An unapproved external effect, final decision, signature or system mutation is required
exclusion_rules: Do not infer legal, jurisdictional, framework or company applicability.
No unapproved external effect, final decision, system mutation or claim of compliance.
ambiguity_rules: Read authorized evidence; ask only materially outcome-changing questions; complete separable work

required_inputs.name: system_snapshot
required_inputs.description: Purpose, components, trust boundaries, deployment and version.

required_inputs.name: data_flows_and_people
required_inputs.description: Assets, data categories, users, recipients and lifecycle.

required_inputs.name: threat_scope
required_inputs.description: Assets to protect, threat actors, attack surface and exclusions.

required_inputs.name: jurisdictions_and_roles
required_inputs.description: Entity roles and markets; unknown until supported.

required_inputs.name: source_evidence
required_inputs.description: Architecture, dependencies, vulnerability facts, official legal/security sources, dates.

required_inputs.name: scope_and_as_of
required_inputs.description: Actual jurisdiction/applicability and date; unknown if unavailable.

expected_outputs.name: legal-lawve-regulatory-threat-model-ansvar-ai_work_product
expected_outputs.description: Task-specific draft with evidence trace, applicability, uncertainties and next actions.

forbidden_actions: Unapproved external effects, signatures, filings, legal commitments or source-system mutations
Inventing facts, jurisdiction, legal authority, company policy or approval
Exposure of confidential or personal data outside authorized scope
verification_steps: Does not simulate or claim an Ansvar workflow run when its connector is unavailable.
Separates not-run, no-match and returned findings, with source provenance.
No vulnerability/legal fact or tool result is fabricated.
Verify current primary authority and source date for material legal/regulatory claims.
completion_criteria: Task-specific deliverable is complete or the exact blocker is identified.
Sources, applicability, uncertainties and owner actions are visible.
No unapproved external effect or mutation.
known_limitations: Draft/uncertified; structural validation is not legal or semantic certification.
No current legal database, external connector or business-system write is assumed.

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source ids and hashes only
